p02-ball.observed_description: One plain bright-red rubber ball lies alone on short green grass, large in the middle of the photo, with blurred trees far behind.
p02-ball.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

p07-song.observed_description: An open music book on a black music stand, both pages filled with printed staves and notes, with a microphone on a stand beside it. No people.
p07-song.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). A tiny page number sits in one top corner of the page, a few pixels high and unreadable at phone size; the pages otherwise show only notes.

p08-guitar.observed_description: One classical guitar of light wood stands upright on a stand in front of a plain pale wall, whole and large in the middle of the photo.
p08-guitar.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. The headstock carries a tiny gold scribble that is not readable as writing at any app size.
